classification_notes.core: Foundations, syntax, text, links, lists, images, media, tables, forms, semantics, metadata and accessibility.
classification_notes.advanced_core: Complex forms, responsive media, native interactive elements, browser behavior, performance, accessibility auditing, security and compatibility.
classification_notes.optional_specializations: Web Components, specialized browser features, microdata, canvas/SVG/MathML integration, HTML email, and deep standards reading.
classification_notes.related_technology: JavaScript DOM behavior, storage APIs, CSS presentation, and server-side validation are adjacent technologies, not HTML capabilities alone.
